discussion_posts_reply_depth_check.name: discussion_posts_reply_depth_check
discussion_posts_reply_depth_check.value: ("discussion_posts"."depth" = 0 and "discussion_posts"."parent_id" is null and "discussion_posts"."parent_depth" is null) or ("discussion_posts"."depth" = 1 and "discussion_posts"."parent_id" is not null and "discussion_posts"."parent_depth" = 0)

discussion_posts_deletion_check.name: discussion_posts_deletion_check
discussion_posts_deletion_check.value: ("discussion_posts"."deleted_at" is null and "discussion_posts"."deleted_by_user_id" is null) or ("discussion_posts"."deleted_at" is not null and "discussion_posts"."deleted_by_user_id" is not null)

discussion_threads_parent_check.name: discussion_threads_parent_check
discussion_threads_parent_check.value: ("discussion_threads"."event_id" is not null and "discussion_threads"."community_id" is null and "discussion_threads"."author_user_id" is null and "discussion_threads"."title" is null and "discussion_threads"."body" is null) or ("discussion_threads"."event_id" is null and "discussion_threads"."community_id" is not null and "discussion_threads"."author_user_id" is not null and "discussion_threads"."title" is not null and "discussion_threads"."body" is not null)

discussion_threads_title_length.name: discussion_threads_title_length
discussion_threads_title_length.value: "discussion_threads"."title" is null or char_length("discussion_threads"."title") between 1 and 160

discussion_threads_body_length.name: discussion_threads_body_length
discussion_threads_body_length.value: "discussion_threads"."body" is null or char_length("discussion_threads"."body") between 1 and 5000

discussion_threads_archive_check.name: discussion_threads_archive_check
discussion_threads_archive_check.value: ("discussion_threads"."archived_at" is null and "discussion_threads"."archived_by_user_id" is null) or ("discussion_threads"."archived_at" is not null and "discussion_threads"."archived_by_user_id" is not null)

events_host_relation_check.name: events_host_relation_check
events_host_relation_check.value: ("events"."host_type" = 'community' and "events"."community_id" is not null and "events"."host_id" = "events"."community_id") or ("events"."host_type" in ('user', 'organization') and "events"."community_id" is null)

events_location_check.name: events_location_check
events_location_check.value: "events"."online" = true or ("events"."city_id" is not null and "events"."location_name" is not null)

messaging_conversations_kind_check.name: messaging_conversations_kind_check
messaging_conversations_kind_check.value: ("messaging_conversations"."kind" = 'community' and "messaging_conversations"."community_id" is not null and "messaging_conversations"."event_id" is null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_low_id" is null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_high_id" is null) or ("messaging_conversations"."kind" = 'event' and "messaging_conversations"."event_id" is not null and "messaging_conversations"."community_id" is null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_low_id" is null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_high_id" is null) or ("messaging_conversations"."kind" = 'dm' and "messaging_conversations"."community_id" is null and "messaging_conversations"."event_id" is null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_low_id" is not null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_high_id" is not null and "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_low_id" < "messaging_conversations"."dm_user_high_id")

messaging_reports_target_check.name: messaging_reports_target_check
messaging_reports_target_check.value: "messaging_reports"."reported_user_id" is not null or "messaging_reports"."conversation_id" is not null

moderation_reports_decision_check.name: moderation_reports_decision_check
moderation_reports_decision_check.value: ("moderation_reports"."status" = 'OPEN' and "moderation_reports"."decided_by_user_id" is null and "moderation_reports"."decided_at" is null and "moderation_reports"."decision_note" is null) or ("moderation_reports"."status" <> 'OPEN' and "moderation_reports"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "moderation_reports"."decided_at" is not null)

notification_email_deliveries_sent_check.name: notification_email_deliveries_sent_check
notification_email_deliveries_sent_check.value: ("notification_email_deliveries"."status" = 'SENT' and "notification_email_deliveries"."sent_at" is not null) or ("notification_email_deliveries"."status" <> 'SENT' and "notification_email_deliveries"."sent_at" is null)

organization_admin_invitations_response_.name: organization_admin_invitations_response_matches_status
organization_admin_invitations_response_.value: ("organization_admin_invitations"."status" = 'PENDING' and "organization_admin_invitations"."responded_at" is null) or ("organization_admin_invitations"."status" in ('ACCEPTED', 'REVOKED') and "organization_admin_invitations"."responded_at" is not null)

organization_verification_requests_decis.name: organization_verification_requests_decision_matches_status
organization_verification_requests_decis.value: ("organization_verification_requests"."status" = 'PENDING' and "organization_verification_requests"."decided_at" is null and "organization_verification_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is null and "organization_verification_requests"."decision_note" is null) or ("organization_verification_requests"."status" in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') and "organization_verification_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "organization_verification_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is not null)
